activity.notes: Bolesław I the Brave ruled the Piast state as duke from 992 but was crowned the first King of Poland only in 1025, a few months before his death. ATLAS therefore binds the royal Activity specifically to the existing Kingdom of Poland polity for the single year 1025 rather than projecting the later royal title backward across his ducal rule.
